g.text: Enterprise Smart Contract Provenance · Explainable ML Delay Forecasting · LangChain GenAI Advisory · 5-Role RBAC
Cross-compiled Single Codebase targeting Web (WASM / CanvasKit), iOS, Android, and Desktop with zero native drift.
Global immutable reactive state (`productsProvider`, `authProvider`) synchronized with GoRouter 14 declarative paths.
Interactive telemetry histograms, line graphs, Inter / JetBrains Mono Google typography, and smooth micro-animations.
High-contrast ISO/IEC-18004 packaging QR rendering and real-time camera decoding directly in Flutter Web and Mobile.
Hardware-backed Keychain/Keystore encrypted token persistence with Dio interceptors automatically injecting JWT headers.
Dynamically computes 1 to 4 columns and safe aspect ratios (1.55-2.7). Automatically reflows horizontal forms into vertical columns.
Desktop: 220px Dark Sidebar · Tablet: 68px Icon Rail · Mobile: Bottom Tabs + Slide-out System & Tools Drawer.
Manufacturer, Distributor, Warehouse, Retailer, Customer dashboards swap dense 6-column tables for touch-friendly cards on mobile.
Multi-threaded concurrent socket server serving Flutter release web bundle to 5+ devices simultaneously on LAN or PAN.
Auto-detects active Wi-Fi / Hotspot IP in 5ms. Eliminates hardcoded IPs when switching from mobile hotspot to office/home Wi-Fi.
Catches abrupt client socket disconnects, returns clean 404s for missing .map files, and avoids server terminal crash loops.
Detects mobile Chrome/Safari auto-prefixed HTTPS requests, responds cleanly, and instructs browser to load plain HTTP.
run_multi_device.bat: 1-Click launcher orchestrating Backend (:8000) & Web (:3000) with dynamic IP banners.
Secure salt generation with adaptive work-factor defense against rainbow tables and brute-force GPU attacks.
Role-Based Access Control enforcing role constraints across Manufacturer, Distributor, Warehouse, Retailer, and Customer.
30-second rolling TOTP secrets compatible with Google Authenticator, Authy, and Microsoft Authenticator mobile apps.
Pre-flight OPTIONS response handling and origin allow-listing enabling cross-device mobile calls across private subnets.
AuditLog Model: Append-only forensic records tracking actor identity, severity, IP, and cryptographic timestamp.
High-throughput async event loop with auto-generated OpenAPI 3.1 schema and interactive Swagger UI / ReDoc documentation.
Blazing fast JSON serialization and runtime constraint validation for product registrations and custody transfer requests.
Declarative relational models for users, products, and custody blocks with foreign keys and multi-block journey eager loading.
Asynchronous client dispatching external telemetry payloads, RFID/sensor updates, and remote smart contract interactions.
On-chain registry executing registerProduct(), transferProduct(), updateLocation(), and verifyProduct() with modifier access controls.
Connects to Ganache/Ethereum RPC node when available, and smoothly falls back to high-fidelity in-memory EVM state store.
Cryptographically binds Product ID, Batch Number, Factory Location, and Genesis Timestamp into an immutable bytes32 digest.
Secret-key authenticated physical seal verifying physical QR labels against tampering or cloning attempts.
Static QR points to verification URL (https://supplychainx.com/verify/{id}) while physical custody advances on-chain.
Every handover links previous_hash to current block_hash, providing a mathematically tamper-evident audit trail.
Gradient Boosting & Random Forest models predicting transit corridor delays based on route, weather, and seasonal volume.
Computes Shapley feature contribution waterfall plots, explaining exactly why an order was flagged with delay risk.
High-speed vectorized data transformation pipelines cleaning logistics telemetry before inference.
Pre-trained ML estimators and Scalers loaded into memory for sub-millisecond scoring during product transfers.
ML Studio UI: Interactive simulator allowing operators to adjust features and view live SHAP feature attributions.
Modular composable chains coordinating prompt engineering, context injection, and structured JSON parsing.
Conversational logistics intelligence analyzing anomalies, summarizing audit trails, and generating compliance briefs.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation matching audit incidents against standard operating protocols and regulatory manuals.
Responsive chat interface accessible on desktop and mobile allowing natural language queries across custody records.
